title: Create app-ads.txt hosting site for Google AdMob verification

requirements.text: Create a minimal frontend that serves the app-ads.txt content at the path `/app-ads.txt`. When a browser or crawler navigates to `/app-ads.txt`, it must return the plain text content: `google.com, pub-7936595519986908, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0` with the correct MIME type `text/plain`.

quotes: app-ads.txt dosyasını sunan basit bir web sitesi oluşturmak

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to https://[canister-domain]/app-ads.txt returns the plain text line: `google.com, pub-7936595519986908, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0`
No extra whitespace, HTML, or formatting is included in the response
The file is accessible without authentication

requirements.text: Create a simple, clean landing page as the home route (`/`) that explains this site is the official developer website for TetrisVerse and that the app-ads.txt file is hosted here for Google AdMob verification. Include a visible link to `/app-ads.txt`.

quotes: app-ads.txt dosyasını sunan basit bir web sitesi oluşturmak

acceptanceCriteria: Home page displays TetrisVerse branding and a brief description
A clickable link to /app-ads.txt is visible on the home page
The page renders correctly on mobile and desktop

requirements.text: Apply a clean, game-inspired visual theme to the landing page — dark background with bright accent colors, bold typography, and a minimal layout that reflects a mobile gaming brand identity. Keep it consistent throughout.
acceptanceCriteria: The page uses a dark background with high-contrast accent colors
The overall style is consistent with a gaming brand

constraints: The app-ads.txt file must be served as plain text with no extra formatting
Publisher ID must be exactly: pub-7936595519986908
The app-ads.txt content line must be exactly: google.com, pub-7936595519986908, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0
nonGoals: No backend logic or canister storage is needed for this project
No user authentication or login features
No game functionality or Tetris gameplay on this site

required: TetrisVerse logo mark with colorful falling tetromino blocks on a dark background (tetrisverse-logo.dim_400x200.png)
